profiles.notesEn: Launcher override: winmm.dll is recommended for unsigned OptiScaler nightly builds (anti-cheat typically blocks unsigned dxgi.dll); version.dll is also an option. Launch from Client-Win64-Shipping.exe. Online game, use at your own risk.
profiles.notesZh: 启动器优先推荐：未签名 OptiScaler nightly 构建推荐使用 winmm.dll（反作弊通常会拦截未签名的 dxgi.dll），也可尝试 version.dll。请从 Client-Win64-Shipping.exe 启动。网游，风险自负。

profiles.notesEn: Launcher override: version.dll is recommended (winmm.dll and winhttp.dll also work on unsigned builds; dxgi.dll is blocked and d3d12.dll cannot enable spoofing). Select Client/WindowsNoEditor/HT/Binaries/Win64 (HT-Win64-Shipping.exe).
profiles.notesZh: 启动器优先推荐：推荐使用 version.dll（winmm.dll、winhttp.dll 同样兼容未签名构建；dxgi.dll 会被拦截，d3d12.dll 无法启用显卡伪装）。请选择 Client/WindowsNoEditor/HT/Binaries/Win64（HT-Win64-Shipping.exe）。
